title: Live Test Pipeline
rule: Every result is published, pass and fail. A failure is promoted on transition only: new, or a changed failure mode. A known failure repeats here with its run counter.

tests.name: Public feed sanitizer
tests.check: The published test data is swept for addresses, hostnames, paths, tokens, ids, channel names and internal service names before it is written. A hit withholds the field and fails this test.

tests.name: Art page labelling
tests.check: Every piece on the art page states how it was made: from code, from a lab signal, or by hand. The audit passes at zero occurrences of the phrase "AI art".

tests.name: Absolute numbers rule
tests.check: Every metric the lab publishes carries its absolute value and its baseline, never only the delta. A lint check fails any note that ships a bare delta.

tests.name: Forged health state
tests.check: A forged all-clear state file, written while the instrument behind it is stopped, must raise a fault from a second signal the file cannot reach. Two readers of one file is a mirror, not a check.

tests.name: Trend watchdog
tests.check: Site health is scored over a 24 hour window of deploys, checks and events; an alert fires on a second-half collapse of activity, not on the last reading. Retention of the window starts first.

tests.name: Watermark and inquire only
tests.check: Every public image is served with a baked-in watermark, originals stay off the site, and the only path to a copy is the per-piece inquiry. Ownership closes the question that framing cannot.
